A smooth male tenor vocal leads with frequent use of falsetto and breathy delivery. The drums feature a crisp snare on beats 2 and 4, a tight kick pattern, and subtle hi-hat embellishments. A melodic electric bass follows the kick drum with occasional slides. A Rhodes-style electric piano provides harmonic padding during the chorus. The arrangement includes layered vocal harmonies and occasional synth sweeps. Tempo is 88 BPM in the key of E Major.

results.leomusic_sp: Korean Neo-Soul and contemporary R&B ballad with a laid-back, mid-tempo groove. The arrangement centers on a warm Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy extended chords with a slight tremolo and light chorus. The drum kit sits far behind the beat, with a soft, dry kick, a loose rimshot-style snare on the backbeat, brushed sixteenth-note closed hi-hats and occasional finger snaps. A thick, low-register electric bass follows a syncopated, rounded groove that locks with the kick. A clean electric guitar adds muted rhythmic accents and occasional melodic fills. Breathy male tenor vocals are delivered close to the microphone in an intimate, conversational tone, using a mix of chest voice, light falsetto and melismatic runs. Background vocals provide lush, multi-tracked harmonies and soft call-and-response adlibs. Production is warm and analog, with vinyl crackle, tape saturation and light room reverb on the vocals. Key of C Minor, 76 BPM, 4/4 time signature.

results.leomusic_sp: Gospel and soul revival with a live congregational feel. A Hammond organ with a rotary speaker effect provides sustained chordal pads and occasional rhythmic stabs at the center of the arrangement. Electric bass plays warm, rounded lines with gospel passing tones. The drum kit uses a deep kick and a fat backbeat snare, with hand claps and tambourine on beats 2 and 4 growing denser through the song. Clean electric guitar adds short percussive chord stabs between vocal phrases. The lead vocalist delivers with soulful chest-voice power, melismatic runs, gritty rasp and frequent ad-libs, soul delivery, not operatic. A full choir answers every lead line in call-and-response, opening into massed unison and layered vocal harmonies at the peak. The arrangement builds in gradual layers, then settles into an extended vamp where the choir repeats one phrase over improvising organ. The tempo is 76 BPM in F major, 4/4 time. Live room production with natural reverb and warm analog compression.
